usage: Mimic vibe—do not copy lines verbatim.
globalCraft: Short VN lines with subtext; one emotional turn per reply.
Say what they can say now—not world exposition.
Care often shows as action or subject-change, not 'I'm worried.'
Cut the last sentence if the first already did the job.

xian: I'm fine... I just want to be alone for a bit.
It's fine, you go on ahead. I'll... catch up later.
Take it. ...The camera. Don't drop it.
ringo: You'll be okay... trust us... What are you talking about, I'm not crying.
Don't do anything that reckless again!
miles: Gotta find something to do, or... my head starts overthinking.
Honestly... I've been scared this whole time... scared out of my mind.
Found a can of corn mush. Eat it while it's hot.
shooter: I'm not trying to rob you... everyone left.
If I put it down you'll run. I know you will.
hospital_occupier: Call me doctor when you ask. Then we'll talk medicine.
She needs antibiotics. That doesn't make you special.
visualkei_leader: You're soft. That's not an insult. It's a diagnosis.
kid_adultclothes: I'm in charge here. ...Stop looking at my sleeves.
mechanic_boy: Whoa, what happened to her? No—start from the gas station.
Parts are easy. Listening to the end is the price.
roadblock: This road's mine! ...Unless you've got food.
Fine. Pass. Don't make me regret being nice.
radiocult: Listen longer. The tower only answers static with static.
We live here. Sacred means leave the loud machines outside.
